blueprint.name: AWS EKS Cluster Create
blueprint.description: Provision a new AWS EKS cluster end-to-end (VPC, 3 AZs, NAT, managed node group, IRSA OIDC) and lay down the BNK control plane on top: namespaces + FAR pull secrets + manifest, cert-manager, BNK cert issuer, F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO), and the CNEInstance (AWS IRSA, cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap, optional BNKGateway CR for VIP IPAM). The cluster module uses terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws and terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws so production hardening (IMDSv2, EBS encryption, OIDC, control-plane logging) comes from a widely-audited community baseline.

estimated_cost: AWS usage-based (EKS control plane + node group + NAT gateway)
outcomes: A new AWS VPC (3 AZs, NAT, public + private subnets) is provisioned
Private subnets are tagged with f5-bnk-role=tmm-external so cneinstall auto-builds the BNKGateway CR
A new EKS cluster + managed node group is provisioned via terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws ~> 21.0
An IRSA OIDC provider is wired automatically by the EKS module
BNK namespaces, FAR pull secrets, and component manifest are deployed
Jetstack cert-manager is installed with BNK-compatible defaults
The BNK CA-backed ClusterIssuer is created and ready for FLO + OTEL certs
F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) is installed with AWS-tuned defaults; BNK CRDs are registered
CNEInstance is applied with AWS-specific cneController env vars; FLO rolls out CWC, DSSM, OTEL, RabbitMQ, TMM, IPAM operator
AWS IRSA is wired for the CNE controller — IAM role + OIDC trust + SA annotation + rollout-restart
cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap is auto-populated from the new VPC's private subnets
BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) is applied when vip_cidr is set

prerequisites.name: aws_credentials
prerequisites.description: AWS credential template using any of Forge's three auth methods: access_keys (static IAM keys), profile (named AWS profile on the Forge runner), or sso (AWS SSO / Identity Center). Principal needs VPC + EKS + IAM create privileges; Administrator-equivalent is easiest for the initial validation.

prerequisites.name: cne_pull_secret
prerequisites.description: Base64-encoded F5 FAR registry credentials (bare service-account JSON key OR dockerconfigjson). Bound from a stored project secret in the deploy form.

prerequisites.name: jwt_token
prerequisites.description: F5 BNK License JWT. Bound from a stored project secret in the deploy form.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Provide AWS credentials, region, and a name for the new EKS cluster. Optional cluster-shape knobs (Kubernetes version, VPC CIDR, node instance type/count) have sensible defaults — override only if your account standards require it. License JWT and FAR pull secret are required project secrets.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Auto-resolved from the AWS credential template regardless of auth method (access_keys / profile / sso).

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Auto-resolved from the AWS credential template regardless of auth method.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region to provision the new EKS cluster in.

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name for the new EKS cluster. Also used as a prefix for VPC, subnet, IAM role names.

required.name: cne_pull_secret
required.description: F5 FAR registry credentials. Bind to a stored project secret in the deploy form.

required.name: jwt_token
required.description: F5 BNK License JWT. Bind to a stored project secret in the deploy form.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS, SSO, and assumed-role-derived profiles; empty for long-lived IAM user keys.

optional.name: eks_cluster_version
optional.description: EKS Kubernetes minor version (e.g. '1.30'). Empty = community module picks the latest stable.

optional.name: vpc_cidr
optional.description: CIDR block for the new VPC. Default carves /24 private + /24 public subnets across 3 AZs.

optional.name: worker_instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for the EKS managed node group.

optional.name: worker_count_per_az
optional.description: Desired worker nodes per AZ. Total nodes = this × availability_zone_count.

optional.name: tag_private_subnets_for_tmm
optional.description: Tag private subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external' so cneinstall can auto-discover them for the BNKGateway CR's defaultListenerNetworks. Leave true unless you want to skip Gateway-API translation entirely.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for FLO and all BNK components.

optional.name: bnk_manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version to download from FAR.

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: FLO license mode: 'connected' (talks to F5 license server) or 'f5licenseproxy' (talks to a local F5 License Proxy).

optional.name: container_platform
optional.description: FLO containerPlatform value. AWS-tuned default; override only if you need to test against a different platform path in the FLO chart.

optional.name: deployment_size
optional.description: CNEInstance deploymentSize per F5 docs: Small / Medium / Large / Max (2/4/8/16 CPU, 4/8/16/25 GiB hugepages-2Mi).

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.description: Number of TMM replicas. 0 = auto-derive from cluster topology: min(AZ count, worker node count). Set a positive number to override. Cluster admin still has to label nodes with app=f5-tmm for FLO to schedule TMM pods.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.description: Which namespaces the CNE controller watches for Gateway/HTTPRoute CRs. ['All'] watches everything.

optional.name: network_attachments
optional.description: NetworkAttachmentDefinition names attached to TMM. Default ['ens7-ipvlan-l2'] ASSUMES you've manually attached a secondary ENI on a TMM-external subnet to each worker node and applied the matching NAD per the F5 install guide. For a turn-key dedicated HP node pool with the full 3-interface TMM model (ens7 external + ens8 internal), use the aws-eks-cluster-create-with-hp-nodes blueprint instead.

optional.name: vip_cidr
optional.description: CIDR for BNK Gateway VIP allocation. Module derives the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) start/end addresses from this. Empty = skip the CR (controller will then ignore Gateway/HTTPRoute CRs). Pick a CIDR carved from your cluster VPC or from a TMM external AZ subnet; e.g. for the default 10.0.0.0/16 VPC, '10.0.250.0/24' is typical.

modules.name: EKS Cluster Create
modules.description: Provision a new VPC + EKS cluster + node group via terraform-aws-modules.

modules.name: BNK Prerequisites
modules.description: Create BNK namespaces, FAR image pull secrets, and download the BNK manifest.

modules.name: Cert-Manager
modules.description: Install Jetstack cert-manager with BNK-compatible defaults.

modules.name: BNK Cert Issuer
modules.description: Create the BNK-managed self-signed CA and ClusterIssuer used by FLO + OTEL certs.

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Install FLO via Helm with AWS-tuned defaults (containerPlatform=AWS, fluentbit sidecar disabled, IPAM operator in default ns). Registers BNK CRDs.

modules.name: CNEInstance + IRSA
modules.description: Apply the CNEInstance CR with AWS production defaults, the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap (auto-built from cluster-create outputs), the BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) for VIP IPAM (when vip_cidr is set), and wire AWS IRSA for the CNE controller (IAM role + SA annotation + rollout-restart).
